brand.claim: Reports season finales and complete seasons from Sonarr.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter the API key Finalarr was started with (FINALARR_API_KEY).

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.emptyBody: Connect Sonarr first and pick the series you want to follow. Airing seasons, upcoming finales and the latest reports will then show up here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.comingSoon: Sonarr, channels and rules follow in the next versions.
